newsitem.title: USA: Gotti son charged with obstructing NY police.
newsitem.headline: Gotti son charged with obstructing NY police.

text.p: The son of jailed Gambino crime family boss John Gotti was arrested in Brooklyn on Thursday and charged with obstructing police officers, police said on Friday.

Police spokeswoman Shelley Greene said John Gotti, Jr., 33, and a friend were held briefly and released but would be required to appear in court to answer a charge of obstructing governmental administration.
Gotti and his friend were driving a sport utility vehicle and allegedly followed an unmarked vehicle of undercover narcotics officers during a "buy and bust" operation.
"The officers stopped and pulled over the vehicle," Greene said. "The occupants were John Gotti Jr. and Steven Kaplan and they were placed under arrest."

Greene said Kaplan, 29, told police there were horse steroids and an applicator in their vehicle. Those items are not illegal. Gotti and Kaplan were given "desk appearance tickets" and released. No date had been set for a court appearance.

Gotti was acquitted in June 1987 on charges that he assaulted an off-duty police officer in 1985. His father was convicted in 1992 of racketeering and other charges related to the Gambino crime family and is serving a life sentence without the possibility of parole.
